patch.summary: ElevenLabs cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: ElevenLabs pricing is plan-gated across 3 researched tiers. Free entry: Free. Trial/free path present in researched plans. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: ElevenLabs cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price ElevenLabs against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (enterprise admin and SSO (Free, Starter, Creator)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (writing and paraphrasing, voice / text-to-speech, ad creative generation) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Credit-based pricing — heavy production usage can spike TCO unpredictably. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.
